text:
deploy-bot: Deploy started — env=staging, tag=release-2026-03-18-rc3, services=[runtime, api, console]. rolling out in parallel (canary 10%). CI: green. links: https://ci.internal/release-2026-03-18-rc3

sam: saw a couple of runtime canaries crash within the first 30s, 2/8 pods CrashLoopBackOff. grabbing logs now :eyes:

maria: thanks, sam. can you paste the pod logs? also which node type?

sam: log snippet:
```
I0320 12:04:33.123 pod.go:211] panic: invalid memory address
goroutine 42 [running]:
  ...
E0320 12:04:33.124 kubelet: Back-off restarting failed container
```
nodes are a mix of A100-40GB and older T4s, canary landed on a T4.

kevin: hmm that smells like a quantization kernel that trips on older GPUs. rc3 added an opt for fused attention that we only tested on A100.

olga: suggest immediate mitigation: pin runtime on T4-compatible build (release-2026-03-18-rc2) for the rest of T4 pool and continue advancing api/console. we can roll the A100 pool forward.

release-eng: proposal: do a split rollout by node class. option A: rollback runtime entirely to rc2. option B: continue on A100 but pin T4 nodes to rc2 (taint/affinity pin). which is faster?

maria: pinning by node affinity is doable and faster. we have a helper script for taint+deploy that we can run: `scripts/rollout/split_pin_by_nodeclass.sh --service runtime --old-tag release-2026-03-18-rc2 --node-label gpu=t4`

sam: running that now. executing in staging.  (running)

deploy-bot: runtime (canary) status: 6/8 pods Ready, 2/8 CrashLoopBackOff -> action: split-pin job started for nodes with label gpu=t4. api: canary healthy. console: canary healthy.

kevin: after pin, can we re-run the quantization test suite on a T4 image? I want to reproduce locally before promoting rc3 to T4s.

sam: yes, kicking off `test/quant-suite --target gpu=t4 --tag rc3` now. ETA ~8m.

deploy-bot: split-pin job completed. runtime: pinned T4 nodes to release-2026-03-18-rc2. runtime (post-fix) status: T4 pool 0/4 failures, A100 pool running rc3 with 4/4 ready. api/console continue rollout: 100% succeeded.

maria: great. quant-suite results look flaky — reproduced a memalignment panic on one test, failing 1/18. attached logs to the run.

kevin: ok let's not promote rc3 to T4s until we patch the fused-attn path or gate it behind an env var. action item: create a patch branch to guard fused-attn and rerun tests. I'll own the patch.

olga: also: update release notes to call out that runtime rc3 deployed to A100 only and T4s are pinned to rc2. add rollback instructions and the split-pin script.

release-eng: agreed. tagging release channel with status and adding a follow-up change window for prod tomorrow 09:00 UTC to complete the T4 rollout after the fix.

sam: thanks — closing staging rollout. will keep an eye on canaries for the next hour. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Deploy finished (partial): env=staging, tag=release-2026-03-18-rc3, runtime=partial(pin to rc2 on T4), api=success, console=success. metadata: commit=9f3b2a4, started=1938765432, ended=1938765550.

kevin: created PR #4826 to gate fused-attn and linked the failing test. assigning @maria for validation.

maria: will validate once CI runs, will post results here.

olga: moving to post-release checklist: update canary dashboards, set alert thresholds lower for next 2hrs, and add note to oncall runbook.

sam: noted. thanks everyone.
